sources.snippet: Write the following lines in it @echo off cd /d "%~dp0" llamafile-0.10.5.exe --server --model "qwen3-4b-thinking-2507.Q4_K_M.gguf" pause Save the run_qwen.cmd file Now you are ready to click on the run_qwen.command file and run the model locally If everything is done correctly, something like this is what would show up in the command window
